verses.1: Look, Jehovah is in the midst of the earth and throughout its regions. He blesses it and spreads its inhabitants everywhere.
verses.2: And it shall be like a people who are like priests, like servants, like their masters. It shall be like a flock, like a herd of sheep. It shall be like a vineyard, like a field of grapes. It shall be like a woman who is pregnant.
verses.3: Let the earth be desolate, and let it be ruined, when Jehovah speaks these words.
verses.4: But the land was destroyed; it became desolate. The sea also became desolate. The people of that land suffered greatly.
verses.5: And the land became fertile under its inhabitants, because the laws were obeyed, and the covenant was fulfilled forever.
verses.6: Therefore, they ate the land. And its inhabitants were destroyed. Therefore, the people of the land were destroyed, and only humans remained in despair.
verses.7: But the poor and miserable will sigh over all the joys of the heart.
verses.8: She sat down, and the whirlwinds ceased to move. She became calm and peaceful. She sat down again, as before.
verses.9: In the song, there shall be no drunkenness; it shall be said that the reward is for those who drink.
verses.10: Nishverah Kriat-Tohu is sealed within every house from the moment it is built.
verses.11: Joy spread across the land at sunset; all joy overflowed from the earth.
verses.12: He remained in the city of Shema and Shaiya, within the boundaries of the city.
verses.13: For in the midst of the earth, among the nations, it will be like a thorn bush that grows up, or like a plant that sprouts from the ground.
verses.14: May they raise their voices in praise to the glory of Jehovah. May they rejoice from the heights of heaven.
verses.15: Therefore, the waters were dried up, and Jehovah appeared to the people in the wilderness. That is the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.16: From the hills of the land, we heard songs of joy. The righteous said, “Oh, give me joy!” But they spoke lies. They told lies and deceived others.
verses.17: Fear and terror will be upon you, O land!
verses.18: And the noise of fear would fall upon the people, and they would be trapped inside that noise. It would be like a prison from which no escape was possible. The rulers of the earth would be destroyed in that chaos.
verses.19: The earth became desolate; it was torn apart. The land was in chaos, nothing was still.
verses.20: The earth trembled, and it became unstable. It was destroyed by sin, and it fell down. It will never be able to rise again.
verses.21: And on that day, the LORD will punish the armies of evil in great pain. He will also punish the kings of the earth for their actions on the earth.
verses.22: And a group of prisoners was gathered together, and they were put in prison. After many days, they would be released.
verses.23: And the flames of fire spread everywhere, as if the Lord’s army was in action on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem. And against their elders, there was darkness.
